states.name: Veldrassen
states.detail: Composite monarchy; provincial bargains, diversified industry and mass armies.

states.name: Ostrevain
states.detail: Centralising monarchy with a large agricultural hinterland and expanding arsenals.

states.name: Rovessara
states.detail: Coastal commercial republic; precision, electrical and optical industries and overseas interests.

states.name: Brannervaux
states.detail: River federation of cities and estates; water allocation, agriculture and chemistry.

states.name: Cervaud
states.detail: Militarised border duchy influenced by larger patrons.

states.name: Veylac
states.detail: Industrial republic with disputed frontiers.

states.name: Ossavren successor territories
states.detail: Former crownlands divided among claimants, provincial armies and separately administered ports.

states.name: Rovengard
states.detail: Monarchy of settled southern valleys and dispersed strongholds.

states.name: Varnesk
states.detail: Mining and industrial league; foundry councils, steels and durable machinery.

states.name: Galdresk
states.detail: Wardenship of chartered orders, estates and teaching houses of the older arts.

states.name: Halskert
states.detail: River republic; seasonal shipping, agricultural valleys and mill proprietors.

states.name: Tervayne
states.detail: Western maritime power; uplands and intervening jurisdictions separate it from Veyrasse. No through railway.

states.name: Vardol
states.detail: Northern power beyond Caldrienne; rival of the inland realm of Averholt.

states.name: Averholt
states.detail: Inland realm of populated basins and provincial bargains; contested frontier with Vardol.

states.name: Serevask federal seat and loyal districts
states.detail: Federal administration retains only these districts; its claims over the other successor authorities are disputed.

states.name: Varnelle
states.detail: Delta authorities retain customs and troops independently of Serevask’s federal seat.

states.name: Kelbrun
states.detail: Upriver councils and plantation interests with separate levies.

states.name: Gavrel
states.detail: Chartered march houses with independent forces; contested federal obligations.

states.name: Karsenne Compact
states.detail: Inland fortress and mining federation. Mountain troops, engineers and defended passes. Essential supplier and uneasy partner of Veyrasse; disputes coastal freight charges and seeks a route through Calvernis.

states.name: Duchy of Caldrienne
states.detail: Northern hereditary state. Strong infantry, artillery and the region’s largest tank concentration. Veyrasse’s principal territorial rival; commerce continues under an armed truce.

states.name: March of Veyrasse
states.detail: Galahad’s home state. A hereditary margrave shares practical power with houses, councils and industrial patrons. Serravonne is a secondary port and railway junction. Standing army, territorial garrisons and household troops defend the March.

states.name: Calvernis Republic
states.detail: Southern commercial republic dominated by shipping, banking and industrial families. Convoy escorts, coastal guns, marines and maritime aircraft. Veyrasse’s trading partner and competitor; potential outlet for Karsenne’s alternative export route.

states.name: Ceralte Admiralty
states.detail: Offshore island power ruled by a protector and naval council. Experienced crews, torpedo craft and minelaying. Treaty partner against piracy and hunters; allegations of sheltering privateers remain unproven.

states.name: Cressault corridor
states.detail: Disputed by Veyrasse and Caldrienne. Defended valleys, a railway crossing, farmland and pumping infrastructure. An armistice ended the previous war without settling ownership. Occasional frontier fire and mutual accusations continue; renewed war is not declared.
